VM - Alias Controller.vi

Owning Palette: Advanced VarMan VIs

Controls the association of an alias with a variable. This VI can be used to associate an alias with a variable, rename an alias, or disassociate a variable from an alias. Note that an alias can be immediately associated with a variable when the variable is created. (see the Referring to variables topic).

Click the parameters for more information

 

VC Handle specifies the handle of the variable context where a desired variable resides. To refer to a global variable, pass value of -1 to VC Handle or keep it unwired. VC Handle is ignored if name_spec refers to a variable by an alias.
name_spec defines the name specifier of the target variable. Usually, this is merely a variable name; however, additional options are available. See the Referring to variables topic for details.
alias specifies an alias name if action is either create or create or rename.
IMPORTANT: In difference with a general format of a name specifier, you should not insert the equality mark before an alias name here. If the first character in alias is equality mark, it is considered as a part of an alias name.
action specifies the operation to perform:

0nopdo nothing (default).
1createVI creates an alias (alias control) and associates it with a variable specified in name_spec. If the variable already has an alias associated, the VI returns an error.
2create or renameIf a variable specified in name_spec doesn't have an alias associated with it, VI creates an alias (alias control) and associates it with the variable. If the variable already has an alias associated, VI renames the alias.
3disposeVI makes the variable specified in name_spec unassociated with an alias.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup VC Handle is a flow-through parameter with the same value as VC Handle.
dup name_spec is a flow-through parameter with the same value as name_spec.
dup alias is a flow-through parameter with the same value as alias.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.
